description: This Java class 'TemporalExpressionWorker' handles persistence and creation of 'TemporalExpression' objects, including fetching from storage, recursive construction, and managing different expression types and their associations within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: TemporalExpressionWorker
classes.description: Utility class for managing persistence and creation of TemporalExpression objects within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getTemporalExpression
methods.description: Fetches a TemporalExpression object from the database using its ID, with validation and optional verbose debugging.

methods.name: makeTemporalExpression
methods.description: Recursively constructs a TemporalExpression object based on its type and associated data, handling various expression types and their relationships.

methods.name: getChildExpressions
methods.description: Retrieves child expressions for composite TemporalExpressions like INTERSECTION, UNION, SUBSTITUTION.

methods.name: setExpressionId
methods.description: Assigns the database ID to a TemporalExpression object.

methods.name: getExpressionTypeList
methods.description: Returns a list of all supported TemporalExpression types.
